criterion: Declared before measuring: one row per (transfer, seed); a transfer passes when the epoch-0 centroid score is strictly lower than the score at the epoch the rule chooses (argmax over phase-2 epochs 1..E, earliest on ties) in the majority of its seeds; the rule is 'adecuada' on the toy set when the majority of the transfers pass (plan v58, Sec. 4.5).

verdict.statement: adecuada: the epoch-0 score is lower than the chosen epoch's in the majority of the transfers (3/3)
